CVE-2026-103995.description: Response body and chunk parsing would handle non-hex or negative integers incorrectly which could result in misinterpreting HTTP response contents.

CVE-2026-115559.title: IMAP4.starttls() wraps the socket in TLS but leaves self._readbuf ...
CVE-2026-115559.description: IMAP4.starttls() wraps the socket in TLS but leaves self._readbuf, imaplib's own read-ahead buffer, untouched. Any plaintext bytes that arrived in the same recv() as the tagged OK to STARTTLS are returned by readline() after the handshake, so the client treats them as the first responses on the protected channel. A network attacker who cannot break TLS can append forged lines after the server's OK, let the handshake complete with the real server and a valid certificate, and have the client accept the forged CAPABILITY and the forged tagged completion of the next command. This is the STARTTLS command/response injection class of CVE-2011-0411.

CVE-2026-115791.title:
When tarfile or zipfile command line interface (CLI) is used to

 ...
CVE-2026-115791.description:
When tarfile or zipfile command line interface (CLI) is used to

decompress an archive, a Python script shadowing the stdlib can be

created. Then if an error occurs during decompressing the next file,

the newly created Python script is executed. This is especially true

if the created Python is called traceback.py. The problem is that

Python adds the current directory to sys.path when python -m MODULE is

run, and the archive is also decompressed in the current directory.



The fix removes sys.path[0] in gzip, tarfile and zipfile command line

interface to prevent shadowing standard library modules from extracted

files.

CVE-2026-116566.title: socket.getaddrinfo() previously accepted null bytes within *host* ...
CVE-2026-116566.description: socket.getaddrinfo() previously accepted null bytes within *host* and *port* parameters which can cause the values to be silently truncated.

CVE-2026-124249.title: http.cookiejar.CookieJar deleted a stored cookie when a response  ...
CVE-2026-124249.description:
http.cookiejar.CookieJar deleted a stored cookie when a response carried an
already expired Set-Cookie header for it, using the Domain and Path
attributes from the header without consulting the cookie policy. A server
could therefore delete cookies belonging to other domains from a shared
cookie jar, such as the one used by urllib's HTTPCookieProcessor. The fix
consults the cookie policy before an expired cookie may delete an existing
one, as required by RFC 6265 section 5.3.

CVE-2026-19552.description: When ca_certs parameter was supplied to ssl.get_server_certificate() function, the identity of the certificate is not checked.

CVE-2026-19672.title:
The tarfile module's tar and data
 extraction filters created dir ...
CVE-2026-19672.description:
The tarfile module's tar and data
 extraction filters created directories outside the destination for 
members whose name leaves the destination and returns to it, such as ../evil/../dest/sub/file. The containment check used the resolved path, but intermediate directories were created from the name as given.

Only
 empty directories are created outside the destination. Member contents 
are still extracted inside it. To return to the destination the member's
 name must contain the destination directory's own final component, so 
extraction into a secure randomised directory is not affected.

This affects POSIX platforms only. On Windows, .. components are collapsed before the path reaches the filesystem, so the directories outside the destination are never created.
